The **fastest animal** on Earth is the **peregrine falcon** (*Falco peregrinus*), which can reach speeds of up to **240 mph (386 km/h)** during its high-speed hunting dive, known as a *stoop*.

### Other Fast Animals:
1. **Cheetah** (*Acinonyx jubatus*) – The fastest land animal, reaching speeds of **60–70 mph (97–113 km/h)** in short bursts.
2. **Sailfish** (*Istiophorus platypterus*) – The fastest fish, swimming up to **68 mph (110 km/h)**.
3. **Brazilian free-tailed bat** (*Tadarida brasiliensis*) – The fastest flying mammal, reaching **99 mph (160 km/h)** in level flight.
4. **Pronghorn antelope** (*Antilocapra americana*) – The fastest long-distance land runner, sustaining speeds of **55 mph (88 km/h)**.
